source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The semaphore guard starts after acquisition, but the completion guard is created only after NotifyAboutToCompact. Early failures before that point therefore release the semaphore without sending a completion for an unannounced phase. Successful asynchronous handoff releases both guards and transfers completion to OnFinalSummary. This is the narrow follow-up to the reported unmatched-notification cleanup path. No compaction or leak test ran.
title: Compaction completion cleanup starts after the begin notification
